notes.title: #1 PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595390/6a2181c5c0501c21f7278fadf94c29cc67329053.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595390/7dad6b0251203d298b2df24c5db92e358f0c2b17.jpg[/img][/url]

1. A Mac OS game build will soon be available. We haven’t seen our coder for a long time, and the handcuffs have disappeared somewhere. Johnny doesn’t say what happened, but he said that a build for Mac OS will soon be ready.

2. A control option for people with disabilities has been added to the menu at the request of a blogger with disabilities, by the way, here's his channel. There you can see the video review and support him. https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=568&v=XYFXl_mjZSc

If your physical abilities are limited, tell us what things should be corrected in the game to make it easier for you to play.

3. The punch is improved. Go ahead, Johnny, hit them with your head!

4. Collisions are fixed: Johnny should stop falling through the ground. If he still falls through, most likely the enemies made a tunnel, and that's not a bug.

5. Text localizations to all languages are added. Johnny has discovered the Google Translate, although he's made translations into some languages by himself.

6. The repeated sound when stopping on "Continue" is removed. In fact, Johnny rarely stands still, so we had no idea that there was such a bug.

7. Fixed: the punch works only when Johnny is on the ground. Now you can't fly in a jump and kick everyone with your head like a superman. Johnny supports fair play.

8. The second boss is more likely to take damage, but when he shoots a grenade, the explosion takes 4 lives instead of 1. And now he has an indicator in the form of a shield which shows when you can't deal him damage.

9. Johnny's shaking when jumping is removed. Or maybe he's just got rid of bad habits.

10. When using the punch and enemies hit Johnny, the hit animation is triggered. The damage taking animation used to be triggered before. Johnny thought it was wrong. 

11. Crushers at the flying level are altered, now they kill immediately after touched. It’s not possible to repair the plane on the fly, the duct tape is good but no, Johnny... No.

12. For 3 seconds after the restart of the flying ​​​​​​​ level, Johnny's plane becomes invulnerable and starts to flash. Fly like a bird, shoot like Johnny.

notes.title: Hardcore Mode
notes.content:
Good news from Johnny for hardcore lovers ːsteamhappyː

We've added the [b]hardcore[/b] mode:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595390/dcaed0bb70441da1a76e31350a85dbc2097ea68c.jpg[/img]
And what's more, there's a special achievement for completing the game in the hardcore mode:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33595390/fc336a5c8d1ecb6405403351198e59d2c02f1f44.jpg[/img]

[h1]Important:[/h1] if you choose the hardcore mode, all your game saves will be deleted and you'll have to play from the beginning.
